848 reviews. 4.7 stars. On a beach island not exactly known for Indian food.

Krishna Garden Pure Veg Indian Restaurant on Tran Hung Dao serves 100% vegetarian Indian food that keeps people coming back hard. Dal, paneer, fresh roti. The kind of meal that actually fills you up after a long beach day.

Phu Quoc has no shortage of seafood. This is the move when you want something different.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
